text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing southerly school bus loading zone in front of Charlottetown Junior Public School be removed, the limits of the existing no standing anytime zone be amended in front of Charlottetown Junior Public School and U-turns movements be prohibited on Charlottetown Boulevard, between Elkwood Drive and Lawrence Avenue East. The proposed parking changes will create four additional on-street drop-off/pick-up spaces and provide a safer environment for all road users.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Amended the existing no standing in effect at all times, on the east side of Charlottetown Boulevard, between a point 298 metres north of Lawrence Avenue East and a point 47 metres further north, to be in effect from a point 298 metres north of Lawrence Avenue East and a point 71 metres further north. 2. Prohibited northbound and southbound U-turn movements at all times on Charlottetown Boulevard, between Elkwood Drive and Lawrence Avenue East.
